Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B.

Start at uga: the pair (uga, kuw) comes first; its second item is kuw, so the next pair is the one whose first item is kuw: (kwu, _).

_ never appears as a first item - so kuw is the dangling end of the chain.

ANSWER: uga, kuw
